notes.title: Pricing page rework, weekly sync
notes.body: Ben wanted three tiers on the pricing page and Chris wanted two with an add-on. We went through the support tickets from the last quarter and agreed on two tiers plus an add-on, so that is settled. Ana writes the copy by Thursday. Ben updates the checkout flow for the add-on. Chris takes the question of what happens to customers on the old middle tier to the finance review next week, because the refund handling stayed open here.
